articles.summary: CD&R, McKesson Corporation (NYSE: MCK) (“McKesson”), and Option Care Health, Inc. (Nasdaq: OPCH) (“Option Care Health”) announced today that they have entered into a definitive agreement, under which CD&R and McKesson will acquire Option Care Health.
articles.title: CD&R and McKesson Corporation Sign Agreement to Acquire Option Care Health

articles.summary: McKesson Corporation (NYSE: MCK) announced today that it has signed an agreement in principle to extend its partnership with CVS Health to distribute pharmaceuticals to mail order and specialty pharmacies, retail pharmacies, and distribution centers through June 2032.
articles.title: McKesson Corporation Extends Pharmaceutical Distribution Agreement with CVS Health

articles.summary: The Board of Directors of McKesson Corporation (NYSE:MCK) yesterday declared a regular dividend of 94 cents per share of common stock.
articles.title: McKesson Corporation Declares Quarterly Dividend

articles.summary: InspiroGene™ by McKesson, a dedicated business focused on supporting the commercialization of cell and gene therapies (CGTs), today announced the publication of its third annual 2026 Cell and Gene Therapy Report: Building the Bridge from Breakthrough Science to Commercial Patient Access. The 2026 report is InspiroGene’s most expansive yet, combining provider research across oncology, rheumatology and ophthalmology, with payer perspectives, patient and advocate insights, pipeline analysis and expert discussion on how technology and artificial intelligence can help address persistent access barriers.
articles.title: New 2026 Cell and Gene Therapy Report Charts the Path from Scientific Progress to Patient Access
